english: Feeding not only restores Rayne's health, it also eliminates an enemy, and you can rotate the victim to block bullets.

english: Use Dilated perception when encountering large numbers of enemies. This gives you ample time to plan each attack.
japanese: Use Dilated perception when encountering large numbers of enemies. This gives you ample time to plan each attack.
chinese: 面对大量敌人时，请使用延缓模式。这样你会有充足时间规划每一次攻击。

english: Strafe back and forth while fighting. Enemies have difficulty aiming at a moving target.
japanese: Strafe back and forth while fighting. Enemies have difficulty aiming at a moving target.
chinese: 战斗时不断左右移动。敌人很难瞄准移动中的目标。

english: If Rayne is hurt and outnumbered, don稚 be afraid to retreat.
japanese: If Rayne is hurt and outnumbered, don稚 be afraid to retreat.
chinese: 当莱恩受伤并且寡不敌众时，不要害怕撤退。

english: Use the harpoon with care. It leaves Rayne exposed and does not work on powerful characters.
japanese: Use the harpoon with care. It leaves Rayne exposed and does not work on powerful characters.
chinese: 谨慎使用鱼叉。使用时莱恩容易暴露，而且鱼叉对强大的角色无效。

english: When there are no doors to open, look for cracks in the walls.
japanese: When there are no doors to open, look for cracks in the walls.
chinese: 没有门可以打开时，检查墙壁上有没有裂缝。

english: Some vehicles have heavy mounted weapons that you can take with you.
japanese: Some vehicles have heavy mounted weapons that you can take with you.
chinese: 部分载具装有重型固定武器，莱恩可以将其取走使用。

english: Use Aura Vision and your compass if you ever get lost.
japanese: Use Aura Vision and your compass if you ever get lost.
chinese: 迷路时，请使用灵光视野和指南针。

english: If Rayne runs out of guns, return to dead bodies for weapons she may have left behind.
japanese: If Rayne runs out of guns, return to dead bodies for weapons she may have left behind.
chinese: 莱恩没有枪时，可以回到尸体附近，寻找之前丢下的武器。

english: If Rayne is at full health and a soldier is running away, you might want to let him go. You never know when Rayne might need a light snack later.
japanese: If Rayne is at full health and a soldier is running away, you might want to let him go. You never know when Rayne might need a light snack later.
chinese: 如果莱恩生命值已满，而一名士兵正在逃跑，可以考虑放他一马。\n说不定之后莱恩会需要一份小点心。

english: If Rayne is in an elevated position with a good view of her enemies, she can use Extruded View to place her bullets accurately and pick off her opponents one at a time.
japanese: If Rayne is in an elevated position with a good view of her enemies, she can use Extruded View to place her bullets accurately and pick off her opponents one at a time.
chinese: 当莱恩处于高处并能清楚看到敌人时，可以使用狙击视野精确瞄准，逐个消灭目标。

english: Rayne has many foes. Sometimes her enemies are more interested in fighting each other than fighting Rayne. Let conflicting sides weaken each other before jumping into the fray.
japanese: Rayne has many foes. Sometimes her enemies are more interested in fighting each other than fighting Rayne. Let conflicting sides weaken each other before jumping into the fray.
chinese: 莱恩有很多敌人。\n有时他们更愿意互相厮杀，而不是攻击莱恩。\n先让敌对双方彼此削弱，再加入战斗。

english: Rayne not only runs fast; she also jumps high. She can quickly get out of trouble if she needs to. Remember to think about leaping up, not just running away.
japanese: Rayne not only runs fast; she also jumps high. She can quickly get out of trouble if she needs to. Remember to think about leaping up, not just running away.
chinese: 莱恩不仅跑得快，也跳得很高。\n需要时，她可以迅速脱离险境。别只想着逃跑，也要考虑向高处跳。

english: Deep water rapidly damages Rayne. Stay high and dry as often as possible. Don稚 run through it if you can jump over it.
japanese: Deep water rapidly damages Rayne. Stay high and dry as often as possible. Don稚 run through it if you can jump over it.
chinese: 深水会迅速伤害莱恩，尽量待在高处和干燥区域。\n能跳过去时，就不要直接从水里跑过。

english: When Rayne fights soldiers, the rebound kick (double-tap the Jump button) will often disarm them. Rayne can snatch his gun out of the air before it hits the ground.
japanese: When Rayne fights soldiers, the rebound kick (double-tap the Jump button) will often disarm them. Rayne can snatch his gun out of the air before it hits the ground.
chinese: 莱恩与士兵战斗时，反弹踢（连续按两次跳跃键）通常能打掉他们的武器。\n枪落地前，莱恩可以在空中将其接住。
